- Public cloud preferred (AWS). No on-prem.
- Workloads: conversational chat + product-embedding lookups for search rerank. Typical request size small (~150 tokens), but high QPS bursts for 5-10 minutes after campaigns.
- Target latency: p95 < 300ms for non-streaming chat turnaround; willing to accept streaming for longer responses.

- Cost sensitivity: mid-level; expects < $5k/mo initially.
